newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely up, rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely up, rangebound.

text.p: CSCE world July sugar futures were trading barely higher in dull midday trade on Thursday, as the July/October spread stood fairly steady, dealers said.
At 1140 EDT, October stood at a 0.12 cent premium to July, compared with 0.11 cent on Wednesday's close.
Producer selling around 11.30 prevented steady buying at unchanged in the July and October contracts, from lifting prices higher.
Dealers said the trade remained an excellent seller of the July/October and the October/March spreads.
Activity should remain rangebound ahead of the July contract's expiry on June 30. Resistance in the most-active October contract was pegged at 11.34 cents, followed by 11.42 cents.
Support was seen at 11.00 cents and then at the recent low of 10.96 cents.

At 1140 EDT, the July contract stood 0.01 higher at 11.16 cents per lb, traded narrowly from 11.19 to 11.14 cents. October was up 0.02 cent at 11.28 cents, while the rest of the board stood 0.03 higher to 0.01 lower.
Open interest in the July contract fell by 4,678 lots to 24,097 lots, as of early Wednesday.
An estimated 10,891 lots changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
